usedFor: Lofty tracks real estate transactions, and Google Drive shares a file when “New Transaction” runs “Share File With Anyone”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Transaction” in Lofty, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A new transaction can hand out a link to its document set at the access level you pick.

watchOut: “Updated Transaction” fires on every update, so it would reshare the file each time.
